name: basics: take inventory of the workflows on the instance
description: Tier 3, live Galaxy. What a researcher asks on arriving: what workflows are here, and which relate to my assay. The subject filter is the hard part -- Galaxy's own ?search drops raw terms under four characters, so delegating 'rna seq' to it matches every workflow, and a naive name substring matches none.
inputs: How many workflows do I have on this server?
How many of them are related to RNA-seq?
Name those ones, and tell me how many steps each has.
